title: Request For Information (RFI) - Sterile Processing Offsite Support
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE HEALTH AGENCY (DHA).DHA ENTERPRISE MED SUPPORT EMS-CD
detail_text: The DHA is conducting a Business Case Analysis to identify alternatives to on-site surgical instrument sterilization for Military Treatment Facilities (MTFs) across eight (8) of the nine (9) networks. The DHA is seeking industry feedback on sterilization capabilities in support of the following MTFs: • Walter Reed National Military Medical Center, Bethesda, MD • Alexander T. Augusta Military Medical Center, Fort Belvoir, VA • Naval Medical Center, Portsmouth VA • Womack Army Medical Center (AMC), Fort Bragg, NC • Evans Army Community Hospital, Fort Carson, CO • Brooke Army Medical Center (BAMC), JBSA Fort Sam Houston, TX • 59th Medical Wing Wilford Hall Ambulatory Surgical (WHASC), Lackland, TX • Carl R. Darnell Army Medical Center (AMC), Fort Cavazos, TX • William Beaumont Army Medical Center (WBAMC), Fort Bliss, TX • 99th Medical Group at Nellis Air Force Base, Las Vegas NV • Naval Medical Center San Diego (NMCSD), San Diego, CA • 60th Medical Group Travis Air Force Base, Fairfield, CA • Army Medical Center (AMC) Joint Base Lewis-McChord (JBLM), Tacoma WA • Tripler Army Medical Center (AMC), Honolulu, HI.
